notes: Single-author Julia CPU implementation. Table 2 reports 'median peak test accuracy' (peak epoch on test, median over 20 FPTM / 4 CoTM runs). CoTM baseline: Table 1 prints '~50' clauses per class; Sec. 3.1 says a pool of 100 clauses; stored as 100 total. FPTM's extra hyper-parameter LF (allowed literal failures) is stored as tm_config.LF; L (clause size cap) as max_included_literals; S (Type Ib 1/S) as s. 256 TA states (one byte) stated only for the IMDb binary model. Fashion-MNIST and Amazon: 'multiple experimental runs' but which run/aggregate is reported is not said. Amazon Sales: n_classes, splits, booleanization and baseline configs not given; whether baseline numbers were rerun or quoted from [14] is not stated. Fig. 2 / Fig. 3 curves (IMDb Table 3 configs S=200 and LF=100) not in text; no record results for them. The paper's 91.70% (early stopping on validation) is hypothetical, not a measured result.
